objective.description: Comprehensive analysis of current eligibility form implementation and infrastructure for GP referral integration
success_criteria: Complete inventory of eligibility components and their relationships
Database schema analysis for patient data storage and GP referral requirements
Security measures and validation patterns documented
Integration points identified for seamless GP referral implementation

current_state.description: SKIIN Switzerland has a robust eligibility questionnaire system with multiple implementations and comprehensive database schema
database_tables: user_profiles_v2 - Enhanced user data with Swiss healthcare compliance
form_sessions - Unified form data with JSONB flexibility
insurance_models - Insurance model types (Standard, HMO, Hausarzt, Telmed)
payments - Stripe integration with Swiss VAT compliance

IntegratedEligibilityFlow.tsx.description: Complete integrated flow with 6 steps: eligibility → contact → verification → insurance → payment → confirmation
features: Payment processing with mock Stripe integration
flow_steps: eligibility - Symptom and risk factor assessment
insurance - Insurance provider and model selection
payment - Payment processing or insurance billing
confirmation - Success confirmation with next steps

EligibilityChecker.tsx.description: Step-by-step eligibility checker with 4 progressive steps
steps: 1. Symptom assessment (palpitations, dizziness, chest pain, shortness)
2. Risk factor evaluation (family history, hypertension, diabetes, age)
3. Insurance model selection (Standard, GP Model, HMO, Telmed)

EligibilityFormV2.tsx.description: Modern modular implementation with branching logic

MinimalInsuranceSelector.tsx.description: Swiss insurance provider and model selection

user_profiles_v2.purpose: Enhanced user profiles with Swiss healthcare compliance
key_fields: street_address, postal_code, city, canton - Swiss address
constraints: Age check - Must be 18+ years old

form_sessions.purpose: Unified form session management with JSONB flexibility
key_fields: form_data - JSONB storage for flexible form structure
insurance_model - Standard, flex, hmo, hausarzt, telmed, self_pay
gp_referral_required - Boolean flag for GP requirement
session_token, expires_at - Security and session management

questionnaire_responses.purpose: Individual question responses with medical classification
features: Multiple response types (single choice, multiple choice, text, etc.)

gp_referrals.purpose: GP referral management for insurance models requiring referrals
key_fields: user_id, questionnaire_id - Link to user and assessment
gp_name, gp_practice, gp_email, gp_phone - GP contact information
status - draft, sent, received, accepted, rejected, expired
workflow: 1. Draft referral created from eligibility results

model_types: hmo - HMO center treatment with lower premiums
hausarzt - Family doctor coordinates all care
telmed - Telephone consultation first, most affordable

payments.purpose: Stripe integration with Swiss VAT compliance
key_features: PCI DSS compliance (only last 4 digits stored)
Billing address for Swiss tax compliance

v2_api_functions: createSecureFormSession - Secure session creation with token
createUserProfile - User profile creation with validation
security_measures: Row Level Security (RLS) on all tables
Service role full access for system operations
Medical data classification and consent requirements

steps.purpose: Collect symptoms, risk factors, and insurance model
Collect and validate email or phone contact
steps.validation: Email format or phone length validation

steps.purpose: Select specific insurance provider and model

steps.conditional: Self-pay shows payment form, covered shows confirmation

steps.features: Summary display, print option, home return

state_management_patterns.session_based: All form data stored in database sessions
state_management_patterns.error_handling: Comprehensive error states with user-friendly messages
state_management_patterns.mock_handling: Development mode with mock data responses

authentication_security: Rate limiting (5 OTP requests per reset period)
data_validation: Credit card validation with type detection
privacy_protection: PCI DSS compliance (no full card storage)
Row-level security for all user data
form_security: Secure form submission with idempotency keys
